ministry: Department of Women and Child Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh
benefits_summary: Conditional cash transfer totaling ₹25,000 across 6 milestone stages from a girl child's birth, immunization, and Class 1/6/9 enrollment up to graduation/diploma admission.
exclusions: More than two girls per family
documents_required: Uttar Pradesh Residence Proof (Ration Card / Voter ID)
Birth Certificate or School/College Admission Certificate
application_steps: Register on the UP Kanya Sumangala Portal (mksy.up.gov.in) under Citizen Service Portal.
Select the applicable stage (Stage 1 to Stage 6) and upload birth/vaccination or school admission proofs.
After Block/District Probation Officer verification, funds are transferred directly via PFMS.
